summary.text: In June 2025, Powell described AI as having transformational potential while weighing whether it would augment workers, replace them, or create jobs. In December 2025, he said AI could make its users more productive while requiring other people to find different jobs. In January 2026, he acknowledged possible near-term job elimination and said AI’s overall effect remained unknown.

statements.text: So this is the question. The question really is, will AI be more augmenting labor or replacing labor? And I wouldn’t—I, I—we all see those announcements, including one today. I wouldn’t overread a, a couple of data points, because, you know, AI should be creating jobs at the same time. It may be replacing—it may be doing both.
